Research · master’s thesis

Digitalisation and structural transformation in ECOWAS economies

Does digital adoption support industrialisation and export diversification? A comparative study of 15 economies from 2000 to 2023.

01

The starting question

This research studies two dimensions of structural transformation: industry’s share of value added and export diversification. It compares the spread of digital technologies with productive change across ECOWAS.

02

The approach

Panel of fifteen ECOWAS countries covering 2000–2023. Indicator construction, checks for missing observations and series breaks, followed by diagnostics and econometric estimation in Stata. The specification is currently being reviewed.

03

Interpretation & limitations

The study examines links between ICT adoption, industry’s share of value added and export diversification. Estimates and robustness checks are under review. Conclusions will be consolidated after the method is validated; observed associations alone do not establish causality.

Work status

Master’s thesis under review. This overview describes the question and approach; the manuscript and final results are not distributed.
